title: Cleaning up Je'zzee's Mess
description: Cleaning up Je'zzee's Mess — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Nielsen

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 100 Shadow Fade Hatchlings in Je'zzee's Gorage located off of the seventh level of Frump's Misfortune. Return to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort on completion.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Nielsen

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Je'zzee Wants Metal and Spit

Zone: Frump's Misfortune

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 100 Shadow Fade Hatchlings in Je'zzee's Gorage located off of the seventh level of Frump's Misfortune. Return to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort on completion.

Offer:

Je'zzee Jaym'zz hasn't been on the job for long and he's already creating problems. We were touring his garage and noticed an infestation of Shadow Fade Hatchlings and this was not their normal habitat. When asked about them, he claimed that he had them imported so he could study their combat formations and dietary habits.

Je'zzee Jaym'zz signed a contract that clearly states that they must maintain those portions of the exterior and interior of the garage under his or her control free from infestation by insects, rodents, or vermin, and from all unsanitary conditions under Chapter 8B page 25 section 1.

We will worry about paying the fine for the violation, but we will need an exterminator to rid the area of those skittering critters. Go to Je'zzee's Gorage located on the lowest level of Frump's Misfortune and remove at least 100 Shadow Fade Hatchlings. Find me, Nielsen, in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when you have finished your bug hunting duties.

Turn-in:

This show is called Monster Toolshed, not Je'zzee the creepy crawly infestation toolshed. Although, it should probably be called the infantile procrastinator garage based on what I have witnessed. Thanks for the help with getting rid of those, but I'm not sure if it's enough to save the show's rating. I fear the show must be on a kill task somewhere.

While you were off stomping on those Hatchlings, Je'zzee went to Chuck McBarris whining that the crew still didn't have enough resources and that's why the project isn't completed and the shooting hasn't started.

If you want to help save the show from being cancelled, come back and talk to me in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort. I'm sure with the amount that's been invested in advertising dollars, we can use some of it to make it worth your while.

Objectives:

  • Shadow Fade Hatchlings

Level range: 25–45
